$comment: PAL-FED-0 dogfood harness configuration (EXPERIMENTAL). Copy and edit paths for the real two-Main run. The coordination DB must live OUTSIDE both source worktrees.

firstRealTopic.statement: Checkpoint polling is the current bootstrap mechanism. Evaluate whether future low-latency peer wake requires a generic Ordarium wait/change-observation primitive.
firstRealTopic.expectedOrdariumResponse: Inspect Ordarium's own architecture and independently respond with constraints / proposal / rejection. PAL-FED-0 must NOT implement the resulting Ordarium feature.

notes: Exactly two peers; no discovery, no registry.
Each Main Agent keeps its own local plan and worktree; messages point at commits but grant no write authority.
Record evidence in evidence/PAL-FED-0-EVIDENCE.md; do not massage the experiment to validate the theory.
